register.labelZh: FIGHT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: fight back 可以描述反抗不公平的壓力、作出還擊,或在落後後重新振作。；fight back 和 fight down 可以用來談論強忍淚水、笑意,以及壓下怒氣、恐懼和衝動。；fight it out 可以描述兩個人或群體持續競爭或爭論,直至分出結果。；fight off 可以描述抵抗感冒、睡意、攻擊、昆蟲或其他不想遇到的問題。
register.summaryEn: Fight back helps you describe resisting unfair pressure, replying to an attack or recovering after falling behind. Fight back and fight down help you talk about controlling tears, laughter, anger, fear and sudden urges. Fight it out can describe two people or groups competing or arguing until a result is reached. Fight off can describe resisting a cold, sleep, an attack, insects or another unwanted problem.
contextsZh: 描述如何控制強烈情緒
說明如何決出勝負或解決爭端
談論抵抗疾病和其他威脅
contextsEn: Describe how people control strong feelings
Explain how a result is decided
Talk about resisting illness and other threats
